# The Portal's Web Desktop card shows a placeholder, not the desktop

## Context

Epic #21061's terminal predicate ends with "the Portal lists the demo with what it proves". `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` lists the Web Desktop as a featured example with `"image": null`. Of the 28 featured examples, it is the only one without a cover; the other 27 serve a screenshot from `neomjs/pages`.

## The Problem

On the Portal's Featured examples tab, the Web Desktop card draws the typographic fallback (a star and "State Provider" on a gradient) where every neighbour shows its app. A stranger choosing what to open sees the one demo built around a polished desktop as the only card without a picture of it. Witnessed on the local Portal at 2026-11-16T03:25Z.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Portal.view.examples.List#getBackgroundImageStyle` (`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs`) layers `url(<imageBasePath>/<image>)` over a gradient. With `image: null` only the gradient renders, and the `portal-example-placeholder` node stays in the card.
- `imageBasePath` reads `resources_pub/website/examples` from `neomjs/pages`: a relative path on GitHub Pages, `raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/pages/main/…` everywhere else. The served copy therefore lives in `neomjs/pages`. This repository keeps the source original beside its siblings in `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/` (`workstation-13-2.jpg`, `dock-choreography-13-2.jpg`, `grid-issues-13-3.jpg`; #19641, #19948).
- The card (`resources/scss/src/apps/portal/examples/List.scss`) anchors the cover top-left (`background-size: cover`, `background-position: 0% 0%`), so a 1280×720 cover crops on the right. Measured on the local Portal: at 1440px the 800×546 card shows image x 0–1055 and its caption covers everything below image y 360. At 375px the caption sits below a 303×210 image box that shows image x 0–1039.
- Precedent: #19640 / #19641 named `devmode/workstation-13-2.jpg` and `devmode/dock-choreography-13-2.jpg`, and neomjs/pages#37 served them. #20679 sets the cover standard for the Grid and Table cards: the example's own frame with the feature in action, the dark theme, a JPEG of at most 150KB, the pages pull request first, and a recorded capture (URL, viewport, theme, interaction).

## The Fix

- `neomjs/pages` (neomjs/pages#87): add `resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg`, a 1280×720 JPEG of about 85KB captured from the demo: Alex Morgan signed in, the launcher, and Mail's window raised into the top band with its "Granted by view-mail to Alex Morgan" chip in view.
- `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg`: the source original, the same bytes as the pages copy.
- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`: the `webdesktop` entry's `image` becomes `devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg`.
- The name follows the `<app>-<release>` convention for 14.0.0, the release that ships the demo (`ROADMAP.md`, "Next: Engine 14").

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 the `webdesktop` entry names `devmode/webdesktop-14-0.jpg`, the source original sits in `apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/`, and `neomjs/pages` main serves the same bytes (the raw URL answers 200 with a 1280×720 JPEG of the same SHA-256).
- [ ] AC-2 on the Portal's Featured tab the Web Desktop card renders the cover instead of the placeholder. The window and its permission chip show above the caption at 1440px and inside the image box at 375px.
- [ ] AC-3 the pull request records the capture: URL, viewport, theme and interaction.
- [ ] AC-4 (post-merge) neomjs.com shows the cover once 14.0.0 is released.

## Out of Scope

- Covers for the 46 other, non-featured examples without one.
- The card layout itself.
- A light-theme cover: every sibling ships one cover, and the demo opens in its dark theme.

## Avoided Traps

- A cover only in this repository: the Portal reads covers from `neomjs/pages`, so without the pages copy the card stays empty.
- A designed cover with a headline: the siblings are raw app screenshots, and the card already carries the copy.
